name: Ona Ken! 2
source:
New girl Ume Tsuyutani joins the onani club and the others take masturbation to new places!!

The club is in crisis when Minori announces suddenly that they no longer have a place to play?
How will they escalate the fun?
How does new girl Ume like to touch herself?

Can Ona-Ken! keep afternoon me-time together?
